resources.string: Environment under test. It starts empty and does not copy the main Masroof database or its preferences.
There is no beta backup to restore.
Your selection sets the processing scope in Beta. Disabling keeps accounts, cards and history. You can optionally import messages from a period you choose.
Could not save the change. Try again.
Manual setup in Beta only. Adding or changing a link does not create a financial transaction.
I confirm that I own this account or card
Could not save. Check the bank, card type and linked primary card. If the details changed, close this window and reopen it.
This asset no longer exists. Close setup and reload the list.
Import bank SMS, then confirm your accounts and cards. Clear transactions are added automatically; only unclear messages need review. Main Masroof data stays separate.

Inbox messages within the selected period are read to identify selected banks. Only eligible evidence is saved in Beta. Limit: 10,000 scanned messages per import. Starting again rescans the period without duplicating saved evidence.
You can add accounts and cards manually without message access. To grant access later, start import again or use system settings.
Period scan complete and interpretations saved. Some messages may still need retry or review.
Scan limit reached; the entire period was not scanned. Choose a shorter period.
The saved scan can be resumed after pausing or closing Beta.
Choose your bank, then optionally import messages or add accounts and cards manually. Review suggestions and confirm ownership and links. The financial transaction summary is not available yet.

Observations from saved evidence only; they do not establish ownership or post transactions. Each evidence item is independent and matching digits never merge assets. Confirm the kind, ownership and parent before saving.
No eligible suggestions on this page. You can add assets manually or continue reviewing evidence.
Evidence not eligible for suggestions on this page: %1$d. It remains saved with its existing status for review.
You confirmed this evidence for the registered asset; it will not add another copy.
The current observation differs from your confirmed asset. Your choice is preserved; review the asset and evidence manually.
Another asset has the same digits; it may be the same asset or a different one. There is no automatic match. Avoid adding another copy if it is already registered.
You selected an existing asset with the same kind and digits. Confirm this evidence refers to that asset. Its parent and card role stay unchanged; no asset or transaction is created.
No saved financial records or corrections on this page. Some messages may still need interpretation, review and financial approval.
The change was not saved. Facts may have changed or this decision may be unsupported. Reopen and review; do not treat it as posted.
Review required; no active financial effect
Review the amount and time, then explicitly choose the type and confirmed endpoints. Viewing evidence does not approve it.
An exact approval request is saved. Retry those choices or cancel the request before making a new decision.
I confirm the displayed amount, time, type and endpoints
Evidence processing is incomplete. Finish reprocessing first.
Enable the bank before approving this transaction.
The evidence, asset or decision changed. Cancel the pending request and reopen the transaction.
A saved correction owns this transaction. Refreshing preserves corrections and suppression.
The pending approval was cancelled. The saved financial decision is unchanged.
The SAR value is unavailable. The native amount is preserved.
The evidence or choices need review; financial approval is incomplete.
These settings and snapshots belong to Beta only. Your regular Masroof data stays separate.
A local Beta snapshot is available
The local snapshot contains Beta data and settings. We validate it before restoring and keep the current state if restore fails. This stays on this device and is not a cloud backup.
Working. Wait for the operation to finish.
The operation did not complete. An invalid snapshot was not accepted. You can try again.
This will erase Beta data and its local snapshot only. Continue?
This will replace Beta data and settings with the local snapshot after validation. Continue?
Beta data could not be opened safely. Files were kept and no replacement data was created. Retry or return to Masroof.
This separate experience starts empty. We do not copy the main app’s data or saved messages. Choose a bank first. Importing phone messages is optional and requires your action.
Your previous Beta data is preserved. Continue opens that existing experience without clearing any data or starting an empty account. Nothing is imported from the main app.
Only after confirmation, Beta data, preferences and local backups will be cleared. Production and device messages are unaffected. New Beta data stays saved across launches.
A manual label stored only in Beta. It does not change the engine result or create a financial transaction. No automatic export or model training.
No current interpretation is ready. Complete processing or explicitly reinterpret the message first.
Long press inside the message to select supporting text, then choose the field and correct value.
Choose or enter the correct value
I confirm this is my correction for the selected text
Saved against an earlier interpretation; not automatically applied to the current one.
